get.summary: List all consents for current user
get.description: Returns a list of all available consents with their current status for the authenticated admin user. Each consent includes its name, identifier, and current state (requested, accepted, or revoked).

200.description: List of consents with their status

401.description: Unauthorized - User not logged in or invalid session

post.description: Marks the specified consent as accepted for the authenticated admin user.

parameters.name: consent
parameters.description: The name of the consent to accept

204.description: Consent accepted successfully - no content returned

401.description: Unauthorized - User not logged in or invalid session

post.description: Marks the specified consent as revoked for the authenticated admin user.

parameters.name: consent
parameters.description: The name of the consent to revoke

204.description: Consent revoked successfully - no content returned

401.description: Unauthorized - User not logged in or invalid session
